note: The player glossary (owner 2026-11-18, decision 349): one plain sentence per game term. Screens mark a word with ui/term.js → gloss(); a tap (or hover) shows the word, the English term in other languages, this line, and a link to the manual. Overlays translate name and text.

terms.name: d20
terms.text: The twenty-sided die. Every check is one d20.

terms.name: TN
terms.text: Target Number: roll it or under on a d20 to succeed. Higher is better.

terms.name: Check
terms.text: One d20 against a TN to see if something works.

terms.name: Difficulty
terms.text: How hard the GM says the moment is. It moves your TN for that roll: Routine changes nothing, Hard is −4, Easy is +4.

terms.name: Margin
terms.text: How far under your TN you rolled. A big margin can earn something extra.

terms.name: Natural 1 / 20
terms.text: The die itself shows 1 (something goes your way) or 20 (a complication), whatever the TN.

terms.name: Crit / fumble
terms.text: On an attack: a natural 1 or a big margin is a crit (ignores armor); a natural 20 is a fumble (a jam, or you are exposed).

terms.name: Passive score
terms.text: Your TN − 5: what the GM uses when you don't roll (do you notice the camera?).

terms.name: Help
terms.text: A crewmate who says how they help rolls a skill: +2 on your next check if they succeed.

terms.name: Contested check
terms.text: Two characters roll at once; the bigger margin wins. Rare: usually the difficulty does the job.

terms.name: Attribute
terms.text: One of eight core numbers: STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA, MST, CRS.

terms.name: Bonus
terms.text: Half an attribute, rounded down. A skill adds two bonuses together.

terms.name: Skill
terms.text: Something you have learned (Stealth, Hacking…). Its number is its TN.

terms.name: Class
terms.text: What you do on a job (Soldier, Hacker…) and, with your subclass, how.

terms.name: Ability
terms.text: A move your class gives you. You equip a few and use them in play. Not a skill.

terms.name: Class TN
terms.text: The TN your abilities roll against: the average of your subclass's two main attributes.

terms.name: Talent
terms.text: A permanent perk you buy with levels.

terms.name: HP
terms.text: Hit points. At 0 you are Incapacitated; at −CON you die.

terms.name: Armor
terms.text: Taken off every hit: what you wear, plus cover.

terms.name: Crack
terms.text: Armor that stopped a location attack loses 1 until it is repaired.

terms.name: Cover
terms.text: Something solid between you and a shooter: +2 (partial) or +4 (full) armor.

terms.name: Condition
terms.text: A state that changes your numbers for a while (Prone, Slowed, Focused…).

terms.name: Injury
terms.text: A broken arm or crippled leg from a location hit. It stays until treated.

terms.name: Boost
terms.text: A short-lived bonus (a stim, an item, the GM). It shows in green, the normal number small beside it.

terms.name: Strain
terms.text: Stress, 0–10. The higher it is, the more it costs you.

terms.name: Credit Score
terms.text: How much the system lets you owe. Official purchases spend it.

terms.name: Cash
terms.text: Street money: untraced, for anything bought off the books.

terms.name: Round
terms.text: In a fight, everyone acts once, in initiative order.

terms.name: Turn
terms.text: Your part of a round: you spend your actions.

terms.name: Action
terms.text: One thing you do on your turn: move, attack, reload, use an ability… You get your Actions number each round.

terms.name: Reaction
terms.text: Something you do out of turn, like a Dodge: it spends an action from your next round.

terms.name: Initiative
terms.text: Who goes first: a d20 plus your Initiative bonus, rolled when the fight starts.

terms.name: Head start
terms.text: Round 0, when the crew knows a fight is coming: a few prep actions before initiative.

terms.name: Scene
terms.text: One stretch of the story in one place. The GM starts a new one; "once per scene" things come back.

terms.name: Mission
terms.text: One job, from briefing to debrief. "Once per mission" comes back at the next one.

terms.name: Downtime
terms.text: The time between missions: you heal, pay, work, and something happens in your life.

terms.name: Move
terms.text: One Move action takes you up to your squares on the map (a square is 1.5 m).

terms.name: In hand
terms.text: You ready two weapons in two slots; only the one in hand attacks. Swapping costs an action in a fight.

terms.name: Attack TN
terms.text: Your TN to hit with a weapon: its skill, plus the weapon's own bonus.

terms.name: Location attack
terms.text: Aim at a body part: −4 TN, and a hit adds an injury or a condition.

terms.name: Reliability
terms.text: How likely a weapon is to jam on a fumble. Higher is safer.

terms.name: Overwatch
terms.text: You watch a direction instead of acting: the first enemy that moves there, you may shoot.

terms.name: Dodge
terms.text: A reaction when you are hit: roll to avoid it, paid with an action from your next round.

terms.name: Hostiles
terms.text: The enemies the GM has shown you, by letter.

terms.name: Wound band
terms.text: How hurt someone looks: Unhurt, Hurt, Bloodied (half HP or less), Down.

terms.name: Ally
terms.text: Someone fighting on your side. The GM runs them.

terms.name: Intel
terms.text: What you know about an enemy type (Known, Studied) or an ally (Known, Full profile).

terms.name: Site alert
terms.text: How much this place's security is paying attention. On Alert and Lockdown, quiet technical work is harder.

terms.name: Street markup
terms.text: How much more than list price the street charges tonight. The GM sets it.

terms.name: Bulky
terms.text: Two-handed or big things: one is free, a bag carries one more, past that you are Slowed.

terms.name: Locked · tracked · hot
terms.text: A looted gun that won't fire, reports where it is, and fetches only a quarter from a fence.

terms.name: Stash
terms.text: A place to keep things off your back: yours, or the crew's.

terms.name: Washer
terms.text: A fixer who moves money between cash and Credit Score, or cleans a hot gun.

terms.name: Haggle
terms.text: One roll to move a price: pick how hard you push and how.

terms.name: Fatigue
terms.text: The body’s wear, 0–6. Tired −1, Spent −2 on physical checks and attacks.

terms.name: Push
terms.text: +2 on a roll, or one more action in a fight, for +1 Fatigue.

terms.name: Breather
terms.text: A quiet moment: −2 Fatigue, once per scene.
